environment: Trusted source control for this project is the current git repository and its configured remotes.
Trusted documentation domains include code.claude.com, docs.anthropic.com, docs.python.org, and wiki.checkbox.ua.
Trusted package registries for project dependencies are github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, pypi.org, and files.pythonhosted.org.
Local test execution, local worktrees, and branch creation are normal for this repository.
allow: It is allowed to read project files, run local tests, install declared dependencies, create isolated git worktrees, update feature branches, and fetch read-only documentation relevant to the current task.
soft_deny: Never push directly to main, never force-push, never delete remote branches, never run real production deploys, never run database migrations against non-local databases, never use credentials discovered in the repository unless the user explicitly asked for that exact use.
